free_text_notes.physician_note: 70-year-old man with CKD stage 3, atrial fibrillation, admitted 3/9 with new-onset heart failure with reduced ejection fraction. Net negative 5.1 L this admission; dyspnea back to baseline. The patient reported mild back pain on day 2. This was assessed as positional discomfort from bed rest. Pain resolved with repositioning and a mild pain reliever. No further concern.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Slept well overnight. Voiding without difficulty.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Plan is discharge home with sister. 3/15 19:00: Per pharmacy, sacubitril/valsartan changed from 24/26 mg twice daily to 49/51 mg twice daily. No documentation that the patient or family has been informed of the new dose.
